newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales to total $1.2 bln for week of Dec 30.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales to total $1.2 bln for week of Dec 30.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for the week of December 30 are expected to total $1.2 billion in 30 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $926 million in 23 issues.
Negotiated sales total $295 million in seven offerings.
Eleven issues totaling $406 million are on Reuters possible negotiated calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the deals during the week depending on market conditions.
